title: German Language – Level 01
overview: This beginner-level German language course introduces learners to essential vocabulary, pronunciation, grammar and everyday communication. Through guided practice and realistic situations, participants learn to understand and use familiar expressions, introduce themselves, ask and answer simple questions, and read and write short messages. The course establishes a foundation for continued German-language study, with integrated listening, speaking, reading and writing practice.
audience: Beginners with little or no previous knowledge of German; students, professionals, travelers and individuals seeking basic German for personal, educational or workplace purposes.
methodology: Interactive instruction, tutor-led pronunciation drills, listening tasks, pair dialogues, vocabulary games, short reading and writing exercises, role plays, visual prompts, guided homework, formative quizzes and end-of-course practical assessment.
competencies: Basic German pronunciation and listening comprehension
Essential vocabulary for familiar everyday situations
Simple spoken interaction and conversational confidence
Reading and writing short practical texts
Appropriate basic communication in German-speaking settings
objectives: Recognize and pronounce common German sounds, words and expressions.
Greet others, introduce themselves and exchange simple personal information.
Ask and answer basic questions about everyday topics.
Use common nouns, articles, pronouns and present-tense verbs in simple sentences.
Understand slow, clearly spoken German on familiar subjects.
Read signs, forms, notices and short everyday messages.
Write simple sentences, personal details and short messages.
Handle basic interactions involving shopping, directions, time and appointments.
